verdict.rationale: Instinct is itself an autonomous personal assistant that users text or call to hand off tasks such as bookings, calls, purchases and email follow-ups. Multiple hands-on reviewers confirm it carried out those delegated tasks. Reports of acting without confirmation, unwanted reservations and bot-blocking on some sites concern reliability, not whether delegation exists. Missing for 10: dependable confirm-before-acting behavior and consistent task completion on bot-blocked sites (airline/card sites).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
